before_en: Unpatched 1.1.1w: 'openssl smime -verify' SIGSEGV in PKCS7_signatureVerify (pk7_doit.c:1009) reading message_digest->length with message_digest = 0xff when the messageDigest attribute is BOOLEAN; ASan SEGV on address 0xff.
before_ja: 未修正 1.1.1w: messageDigest 属性が BOOLEAN のとき 'openssl smime -verify' が PKCS7_signatureVerify (pk7_doit.c:1009) で message_digest = 0xff の message_digest->length を読み SIGSEGV。ASan はアドレス 0xff の SEGV。
after_en: Patched build: 'PKCS7_signatureVerify:unable to find message digest', Verification failure, exit 4, no crash/ASan report for BOOLEAN, NULL and INTEGER variants.
after_ja: 修正版: BOOLEAN、NULL、INTEGER 変種すべてで 'PKCS7_signatureVerify:unable to find message digest'、Verification failure、exit 4。クラッシュ・ASan 報告無し。
method_en: Opaque signed PKCS#7 (DER) from openssl smime -sign -nodetach; Python DER re-encoder replaces the messageDigest value type; openssl smime -verify -noverify on BASE/BASE-ASAN/PATCHED/PATCHED-ASAN; gdb; valgrind.
method_ja: openssl smime -sign -nodetach で opaque 署名 PKCS#7 (DER) を作り、Python の DER 再エンコーダで messageDigest 値の型を置換。openssl smime -verify -noverify を BASE/BASE-ASAN/PATCHED/PATCHED-ASAN で実行、gdb、valgrind。
regression_en: good.p7 verifies (content identical, with -CAfile, under ASan); patched sign+verify (S/MIME, detached DER) succeed; tampered content detected; valgrind clean.
regression_ja: good.p7 の検証成功 (内容一致、-CAfile、ASan 下)。修正版での署名+検証 (S/MIME、分離 DER) 成功。改ざん検出も維持。valgrind クリーン。
limitations_en: Only the BOOLEAN encoding crashes the unpatched build; first run_poc.sh run had scripting defects in the regression helper/verdict counting, fixed and re-run.
limitations_ja: 未修正ビルドのクラッシュは BOOLEAN 符号化のみ。run_poc.sh 初回は回帰用補助と判定カウントに不備があり、修正して再実行。
